notes.title: Ord. Storyteller Update is out now!
notes.content:
Hello,

Our newest update to Ord. is finally here!

[list]
[*] The game has been localized into 5 additional languages: French, German, Japenese, Russian and Spanish.
[*] A new short story, Heist, by guest writer, Emma Levin.
[*] Steam Workshop support now allows you to create, share and play your own stories.
[/list]

If you're interested in starting to create your own stories, the official workshop guide can be found: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2194934861]here[/url].

Have a great year,

Joni, Fynn, Josh & Pedro

notes.title: Ord. Storyteller Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We are very happy to announce that a new update will be coming to Ord. next week!

The Storyteller Update for Ord. includes:

[list]
[*] A new story, Heist.
[*] Localization for 5 new languages: German, French, Russian, Japanese, and Spanish.
[*] Workshop support: create, share, and enjoy stories made by the community!
[/list]

The update will be available on December 31st.

Thanks,

Joni, Fynn, Josh & Pedro

Workshop support: create, share, and enjoy stories made by the community!

notes.title: Ord. Big Free Update!!
notes.content:
[b]The Big (and free) Update for Ord. is out!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35062420/bfc7512910bcd4d8684631a002e4c67e522a78e7.png[/img]

The Big Update adds 3 new stories to Ord.:

[list]
[*] [b]Dimensions[/b]
Prepare for dimension-hopping escapades as you try to find a way back home!
 
[*] [b]World[/b]
Take on the role of a god and build your own world. Will it prosper or perish?
 
[*] [b]Foul Things (written by Skruffye)[/b]
Rediscover the helplessness of childhood and escape the hunger of the Foul Things...
[/list]

Additionally, the amazing Damion Sheppard composed an interactive soundscape that makes Ord. come to life!

And on top of all this, the game is on discount from 31st to 8th to celebrate! 

We hope you have fun with this free update, and hopefully we'll be able to improve the game more as time goes on. Let us know what you think!

Cheers,
Fynn, Joni, Pedro & Josh

notes.title: Announcing New Stories & Audio
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35062420/7efe3293dda3af98b8af23ad91726aa954844282.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35062420/b0e393a2206b2f2c1f550a8f9f0f221a198616b2.png[/img][/url]

Heyo dear Steam Users!

We are currently hard at work on a [b]free update[/b], which will be released in the end of August!
This Update will consist of:
[list]
[*] New Stories by New Writers
[*] Sound Effects by the amazing Damion Sheppard
[/list]

We are also currently reaching out to more Streamers, Reviewers and Curators, so if you know anyone who might enjoy Ord., please do not hesitate to tell us :D

Also, to the people who are waiting for achievements to be usable on profile pages: We still have not hit the numbers for that, but we are confident we will!

We hope you have a nice August and wish you all the best!

Cheers,
Fynn, Joni & Josh
